verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a crypto payments and ramp platform, so a programmatic stablecoin payout API is a fair question to ask. The evidence only shows user-driven on-ramp buys and a widget-based off-ramp where the end user sells crypto and picks a fiat payout method. Nothing documents a developer-initiated API call that sends stablecoins to a wallet address or stored recipient and tracks it to final settlement; generic webhooks alone do not establish this.
